content: Jesus a afalafal usun talan ewe imwenfel
Iwe, lupwen Jesus a towu seni ewe imwenfel, eman lein nöün kewe chon kaiö a üreni, “Sense, nengeni lingöchün ekewe fau me ekewe imw!”
Nge Jesus a üreni, “Ka küna ekewe imw mi watte? Esap fokun wor eföü fau epwe chüen nom lon lenian. Ekewe fau meinisin repwe toropasetiu.”
Riaföü me ninni
Lupwen Jesus a mot won ewe chukun Olif pekilan ewe imwenfel, Petrus, James, Johannes me Andru chök ra feila ren.
Ra kapas ngeni, “Kose mochen ürenikem inet ekei mettoch ka fos usun repwe fis. Kopwe pwäri ngenikem asisilen fisin ekei mettoch meinisin.”
Iwe, Jesus a üreniir, “Oupwe mamasa, pwe esap wor eman epwe atupukemi.
Chomong aramas repwe feito fän itei o apasa, ‘Ngang Kraist.’ Iwe, repwe atupu chomong aramas.
Nge lupwen oupwe rongorong akürangen maun me pworausen maun, ousap niuokus. Ekei mettoch repwe fokun fis, nge esap tori mwo fansoun sopolan.
Ekewe fanü repwe fiufengen o ekewe mwü repwe maunfengen. Epwe wor chechen fanü me lengita ekis meinisin. Ekei riaföü ra usun chök ekewe metek eman fefin a eäni mwen an epwe nöünöüla.

Oupwe püsin mamasakemi. Pun repwe fötekinikemi o emwenikemiilong lon kapwüng. Repwe wichikemi lon ar kewe imwen felikis. Oupwe ütä mwen ekewe kepina me king pokitei, pwe oupwe pwärätä ngeniir mine a let.
Nge ewe Pworausen Manau epwe akom tori aramasen fanüfan meinisin.
Iwe, lupwen repwe fötekinikemi o emwenikemiilong lon kapwüng, ousap öüreki me mwan mine oupwe apasa. Lon ewe chök otun epwe torikemi mine oupwe apasa, pun sap ämi oupwe kapas, nge ewe Ngünmifel.
Iwe, pwipwi repwe afangamä pwiir ngeni mäla, eman sam epwe afangamä nöün, nge ekewe nau repwe ü ngeni semer me iner o aturuur, pwe repwe ninnila.
Aramas meinisin repwe oputakemi pokitei. Nge iö epwe likitü tori lesopolan epwe küna manau.
Ewe mettoch mi eniweniw
“Ämi oupwe küna ewe ‘Mettoch mi Eniweniw’ a nom lon ewe leni ia esap ürürün epwe nom ie. (Ewe chon aleani epwe fokun weweiti met wewen ei!) Mürin chokewe mi nom lon Jutea repwe sütä won ekewe chuk.
Eman aramas mi nom won imwan, esap wor an fansoun an epwe tötiu o tolong lon imwan pwe epwe angei och.
Nge eman mi nom lemäl, esap liwiniti imwan an epwe angei üfan sekit.
Riaföün ekewe fefin mi pwopwo me ekewe inelap mi oupwu nöür lon ekana rän.
Oupwe iotek pwe ei sokun riaföü esap fis lon fansoun patapat.
Pun riaföün lon ekana rän epwe fen lap seni ekewe riaföü mi fen fis seni lepoputän, lupwen Kot a föri fanüfan tori ikenai, esap pwal fissefäl ena sokun lon ekewe fansoun repwe feito.
Nge are ach Samol esap amochomocha ekewe rän, esap wor eman aramas epwe manau. Nge pokiten chokewe a filiiretä a amochomochala ekewe fansoun riaföü.
Lon ena fansoun are eman epwe apasa ngenikemi, ‘Nengeni, iei i Kraist,’ ika ‘Nengeni, a nom ikenan,’ ousap lükü i.
Pun kraist chofona me soufos chofona repwe war o föri asisil me manaman, pwe repwe atupu ekewe chon fil are repwe tongeni.
Iei mine oupwe mamasa. Ngang üa pwäri ngenikemi ekei mettoch meinisin mwen ar repwe fis.
Liwinsefäliton Nöün Aramas
“Lon ekana rän, mürin ewe fansoun riaföü, akkar epwe rochola, maram esap chüen tittin,
ekewe fü repwe turutiu me läng, nge ekewe manamanen läng repwe mwöküt seni lenier.
Lon ena fansoun aramas repwe küna Nöün Aramas epwe feito won kuchu ren manaman me ling mi lapalap.
Mürin epwe tinala ekewe chon läng lepelien fanüfan me rüanü, pwe repwe achufengeni nöün kewe chon fil seni lesopun fanüfan tori lesopun.
Kapasen kait seni ewe irä fiik
Oupwe kaiö eu lessen seni ewe irä fiik. Lupwen palan kana ra anüen fetil o popuetä le pwüküwu chöön, oupwe silei pwe a arap fansoun räs.
Iei usun lupwen oupwe küna pwe ekei mettoch repwe fis, oupwe silei pwe ewe fansoun a arapoto o molotä ngeni ar repwe pwönüetä.
Enlet, üpwe ürenikemi, pwe ei pilon aramas resap mäla, tori an epwe fisitä ekei mettoch meinisin.
Läng me fanüfan repwe morola, nge ai kapas kana resap fokun morola.
Esap wor eman a silei ewe rän are ewe kulok
“Esap wor eman a silei ewe rän are ewe kulok ekei mettoch repwe fis lon, ekewe mwo chon läng, ika ewe Nöün Kot resap pwal silei, pwe ewe Sam chök.
Oupwe mamasa o afälikemi, pun ousap silei inet ewe fansoun epwe war lon.

Epwe usun chök eman mwän a saila toau, nge a likitala nöün chon angang pwe repwe tümwünü meinisin mine a eäni. A awisa ngeni eman me eman an angang o allük ngeni ewe chon mamasa ewe asamalap, pwe epwe mamas.
Iei mine oupwe mamasa, pun ousap silei inet samolun ewe imw epwe war, are epwe war lekuniol, are lukenipwin, are wünümweerän, are lesosor.
Are epwe müttir feito, esap öch an epwe künok lon om möür.
Mine üa ürenikemi, üa üreni aramas meinisin: Oupwe mamasa.”
